messages:
sasha_sales: Heads-up: RFI from BlueHaven — they want embedding throughput pricing, on-prem network peering requirements, and a capability matrix attachment. Need concise answers and attachments by Monday. Threading here to collect.
michael_se: Copy. Do we have an up-to-date embedding rate card? I can draft per-embedding and per-1k-token numbers for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private.
ritesh_eng: For on-prem peering: latency and throughput depend on VLAN peering, firewall rules, and whether they allow our agent outbound to S3 for model fetches. Need expected QPS and average embedding batch size.
sasha_sales: They specified burst to 100 qps and sustained 30 qps. On-prem will be in their AWS VPC; they want a peering or PrivateLink option. Also asked if we can provide fixed egress IP ranges.
michael_se: We support VPC peering + AWS PrivateLink. Notes to include in RFI:
```
- Private deployment options: VPC peering OR AWS PrivateLink
- Required outbound: model fetch (S3 endpoints) unless model pre-pinned to local storage
- Ports: 443 outbound to Redwood control plane + agent SSL port inbound as configured
- Recommended: enable cross-AZ routing and allow KV cache sync traffic if using shared cache
```
natalie_sec: Security bullets for RFI draft:
- Data in transit: TLS 1.2+ enforced; mTLS optional for Private
- Data at rest: customer-managed KMS supported; optional BYO-HSM integrations
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II, ISO27001; export controls and data residency notes included
- Retention: configurable retention windows and deletion controls
sasha_sales: Great. Can we confirm whether we can provide static IP ranges for egress? Customer wants that in RFI.
ritesh_eng: For Dedicated we can publish stable egress ranges per-region. For Private (customer VPC) egress is under their control but we can provide expected CIDR blocks used by our agents. Will confirm exact ranges tomorrow.
michael_se: Draft rate card for RFI (high-level):
- Hosted embeddings (small models): $0.0004 per embedding
- Hosted text gen: $0.0012 per 1k tokens
- Dedicated: monthly reserved capacity + discounted per-embedding/token overage
- Private: enterprise license + optional support/ops addon
I'll attach a compact capability matrix with these tiers.
sasha_sales: Perfect. For the capability matrix we also need a short "recommended config" row (batching, cache, quantization profile). @natalie_sec can you sign off on the security bullets for customer-facing doc?
natalie_sec: Approving with one edit: change "HSM options" -> "optional HSM integrations (bring-your-own HSM supported)". Also add export compliance and retention controls. :white_check_mark:
deploy_bot: deploy-bot: Attachment uploaded: rfi_bluehaven_matrix_v2.xlsx (link: https://files.redwood/repo/ids/12345) :paperclip:
sasha_sales: Perfect. I'll assemble final RFI package: michael's rates + ritesh's network checklist + natalie's security bullets + the matrix link. Will ping legal for a short review. Thanks all.
michael_se: One more note to add to the matrix: embeddings throughput scales with batching — recommend client batch size ~16 for cost/latency tradeoff when targeting 100 qps.
sasha_sales: Good call — I'll add that under "recommended config".
